title: Detect when a short consistency filter leaves expensive trace multiplicity
statement: The causal residual map(x,y)->(x,e) is bijective. A rank-r parity filter on s residual bits leaves2^(n+s-r) traces. Recovering arbitrary original counts from its power-of-two residue still requires at least n+s-r+1 bits before division.

requires: Topologically ordered Boolean circuit and exact rank-r residual filter
provides: The causal residual map(x,y)->(x,e) is bijective. A rank-r parity filter on s residual bits leaves2^(n+s-r) traces. Recovering arbitrary original counts from its power-of-two residue still requires at least n+s-r+1 bits before division.
assumptions: This is a boundary of this filtering/reconstruction mechanism, not all counting algorithms
costs: Residual multiplicity and reconstruction precision must be charged
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: A short filter alone does not remove the internal-state counting cost.

body: Signed selectors preserving both constant and full-parity observables require degree>=s; output-specific rank-one filters can still retain exponential multiplicity.
